title: Setu: Academia-Industry Collaboration Portal
description: Smart India Hackathon 2026 project (PS 26044). Turns students' self-assessed skills into a measurable profile and ranks internships against it with an explainable scoring algorithm. Companies get applicants ranked by match score.

title: CyberShield: Explainable Phishing Detector
description: Paste a suspicious SMS, email or link and get a Low, Medium or High risk rating with reasons and safety advice. Combines a blocklist, an ML model trained on about 235,000 URLs and rule-based scam-language analysis.

title: Portfolio Website
description: This site. An Express server serves the pages and a /api/projects endpoint that feeds the project cards.
